decision: South Fork Iowa River / USGS 05451210 is the first reproducible scientific watershed artifact: gauge-specific NLDI geometry, passed major-dam screen, official 2019 NASS CDL HRU overlay, complete TxtInOut, and a paired real SWAT+ baseline/coupled run on the same source project and forcing. The CDL classification is explicitly a static snapshot.
future_spatial_validation: NOT_STARTED: this milestone verifies the first static-CDL watershed build and paired engine execution only; multi-period calibration, time-varying crop history, and formal spatial validation remain out of scope.
